content.text:
**What I decided:** Open a securities account at פסגות and buy the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund, number 5139282. I'm fairly sure. What decided it was the first screen: it marks that pair "הבחירה שלכם · הזול ★" and shows 86,492 ₪ after 10 years. The fund fee is "0.02%", and the account fees come to "1,057 ₪" over 10 years. Way down the page, the "נקודת התחלה ועד הכי הרבה" chart ends on the same pair at 86,492 ₪, so it clicked.

**How it went:**
- **Screen 1.** The heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן" is exactly what I came for. S&P 500 was already picked. The sliders were set to 10,000 today and 500 a month, not my 30,000. I left them, because these are just pictures, so all the numbers are for 10,000, not mine.
  - 70,000 deposited turns into 86,492. I thought 7% a year would give way more than that.
  - "זוג הבא בתור" shows 86,449 (‎−43 ₪). Basically the same, so the gap didn't matter to me.
  - The coloured bar says "5,703 / 356 / 699". I had to go down to the legend to match the colours: pink is probably "מס", yellow is "דמי משמרת", orange is "עמלות קנייה ומכירה". That's a guess.
- **Screen 2.** Two long lists side by side. Funds on the left, banks on the right: פסגות, לאומי, וואן זירו, הבינלאומי, מסד… The bank numbers go down from there. I scrolled fast.
  - Every fund repeats the same chips: "צוברת", "חשיפה לדולר", "קרן סל", "מס גם על שינוי המטבע". I kept rereading them to find what's different on each line. Annoying.
  - Some say "אין מחיר כאן" and "IE00…" in English, so I skipped those.
- **Screen 3.** "הראל מחקה מנוטרלת מט"ח" shows "בין 2,212+ ל־‎−23,766". A wide range with a minus scared me off it. I didn't read the text block about "מה כתוב בפרסום". I glanced at "מה הכי משנה את מה שיישאר לכם", where adding 20% more years gives +19,116.
- **Screen 4.** The whole part about the dollar, "עם נטרול מט"ח או בלי", went over my head. I skimmed it.
- **Screen 5.** The step chart was confusing. It starts at MTF / ירושלים, 79,176, which isn't something I ever picked. But it climbs to the same 86,492 at פסגות + ילין לפידות, so that confirmed it.
- **Screen 6.** Small grey text, skipped.

**Words I didn't get:** "4D", "צוברת", "עסקת החלף", "דמי משמרת", "מנוטרלת מט"ח", "UCITS", "W-8BEN", "IE00B5BMR087", "חשיפה לדולר", "מס רק במכירה", "קרן זרה".

**Where I'd have bailed:**
- Screen 4, the dollar stuff. I would have closed it there if I hadn't already decided.
- Screen 2 was also long and wore me out.

I still don't know if I'll get the same result with 30,000 instead of 10,000. Also, I've never heard of ילין לפידות, though I know פסגות.
